FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The camera pans over a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor and ladies in flowing gowns hurrying about their daily business. But amidst the chaos, a sense of unease settles over the land. The king, a stout and proud man named KING ARTHUR, sits upon his throne, his eyes fixed upon a strange and wondrous object in his hand.

KING ARTHUR
(to his advisor, LORD THOMAS)
Behold, my loyal subject! I have acquired the most marvelous contraption from the farthest reaches of the empire. 'Tis a... a... (he consults a small, leather-bound book)...a "Vaporwave Generator"!

LORD THOMAS
(skeptical)
Your Majesty, I'm not sure what to make of this... device. Is it not a bit... unorthodox?

KING ARTHUR
(firmly)
Nay, my lord! This is the future! Behold, as I activate the Vaporwave Generator! (he flips a switch, and a strange, pulsating light fills the room)

The camera zooms out, and the kingdom begins to transform before our eyes. The stone walls turn a deep, iridescent purple, and the thatched roofs of the cottages begin to shimmer and glow. The knights and ladies, once dressed in their finest armor and gowns, now wear garb that seems to shift and writhe like living things.

KING ARTHUR
(excitedly)
Behold, my subjects! Our empire shall be reborn in the image of... of... (he consults his book again)...of "Neon Dreams"!

As the king speaks, the camera pans across the kingdom, taking in the surreal landscape. The sound of distant, distorted synths and the hum of machinery fill the air, and the very fabric of reality seems to bend and warp.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. They all wear strange, futuristic attire, and their faces are painted with vibrant, neon colors.

KING ARTHUR
(to his courtiers)
My dear subjects, I decree that henceforth, our empire shall be known as... as... (he consults his book once more)...as "Vaporwave Kingdom"!

LORD THOMAS
(sarcastically)
Oh, joy. Because nothing says "medieval majesty" like a kingdom of neon-lit, synth-heavy weirdness.

KING ARTHUR
(firmly)
Nay, my lord! This is the future! And I, King Arthur, shall be its leader! (he raises his hand, and the camera zooms in on his face)

As the king speaks, his eyes seem to gleam with an otherworldly intensity, and his voice takes on a strange, hypnotic quality.

KING ARTHUR
(to the camera)
I am King Arthur, ruler of the Vaporwave Kingdom. And I shall bring order and... and... (he consults his book once more)...and "J-Pop" to this land!

The camera zooms out, and the kingdom is bathed in a warm, golden light. The sound of distant synths and machinery grows louder, and the very fabric of reality seems to vibrate with an otherworldly energy.

FADE TO BLACK.
